capabilities: Delete task lines shortly after their checkbox is ticked
Strip completed lines on external writes and Dataview checkbox clicks
Insert new task lines via ribbon button or command
Sweep all completed tasks from the active note on demand
disambiguation: Not a task manager; it only removes completed task lines and inserts new ones, it does not track or organize tasks.
extras: No settings page in this release; the delete delay and checkbox filters are not configurable. Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wanted notes to function like a todo app, not accumulate a graveyard of strikethrough completed tasks.
problem: Completed tasks normally stay in files as - [x] lines, which becomes noise for people who want notes to act like a todo app rather than a log.

relations.evidence: Compatible with Dataview TASK queries — checking a task in an embedded Dataview result triggers the auto-delete.

summary: Task-line cleanup plugin that deletes a task line shortly after its checkbox is marked done, keeping notes free of completed tasks.
